title: viola arvensis subsp. parvula
intro: Viola arvensis subsp. parvula, commonly known as Dwarf Field Pansy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the violet family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Viola arvensis subsp. parvula include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, sedative, and expectorant, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as anxiety, coughs, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Viola arvensis subsp. parvula include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
